title: Liouville's Theorem
text:
Several theorems are attributed to the French mathematician Joseph Liouville. They include the following.

  • Liouville's Theorem (complex analysis), which states that bounded every complex-differentiable function on the entire complex plane is constant.
  • The Liouville Approximation Theorem, a result on transcendental numbers.
